purpose: Replay each topology against its own frozen c16 oracle to localize run-to-run nondeterminism.

pilot_observations.tp1_vs_tp2_boundary: Topology changes numerical trajectories and is not itself a determinism test. Each replay uses its own topology-specific oracle.

gate: Each replay must match its own frozen oracle 16/16, form one admission cohort, complete all token IDs, use zero cached tokens, have zero cross-base collisions, remain WDC-negative, and pass kernel/cleanup gates.

failure_interpretation.TP1_fail: Nondeterminism exists without cross-GPU collectives; prioritize shared SYCL kernels/fusions.
failure_interpretation.both_pass: The original defect requires higher concurrency/pressure; scale upward without changing other variables.

publication_policy: All rates remain diagnostic during localization. Exactness is mandatory before optimization or publication.
